fields.name: slot0_header_word0
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x000-0x001 of cap-01-future-1.sav; no corroborating second sample to confirm meaning.

fields.name: slot0_counter_candidate
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x002-0x003; plausible generation/write counter, not confirmed to increment (only one sample).

fields.name: magic_c0de600d
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x004-0x007 of slot 0; recognizable hex-speak constant pattern (C0DE/600D) but not code-verified.

fields.name: slot0_reserved
fields.evidence: All-zero in the only sample; could be reserved or legitimately zero at this game state.

fields.name: slot0_trailer_candidate
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x00C-0x00F; identical value recurs at 0x0AC and 0x14C despite differing preceding content.

fields.name: slot1_field_0
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x0A0-0x0A1; differs in value from the equivalent slot-0 position (ffff vs 0000), suggesting header vs payload slot-type distinction.

fields.name: slot1_field_1
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x0A2-0x0A3; constant between slot 1 and slot 2; no second distinct sample to determine if this varies with game state.

fields.name: slot1_reserved
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x0A4-0x0AB; all-zero in the only sample.

fields.name: slot1_trailer_candidate
fields.evidence: Byte offset 0x0AC-0x0AF; identical to slot0_trailer_candidate and slot2_trailer_candidate.

fields.name: slot2_block
fields.evidence: Byte-for-byte identical to slot 1 (offset 160-175); consistent with but not proof of a primary/backup mirror design.

fields.name: slot3_block0
fields.evidence: Matches the slot1/slot2 payload pattern; block-write mechanism itself is proven by decompiled code, but the field's game meaning is not.

fields.name: slot3_block1_unwritten
fields.evidence: Direct byte observation; central proof that slot writes are split into independent 8-byte EEPROM block commits (see FUN_0802f4d0/FUN_0802f4e4 in io_driver_functions).

fields.name: reserved_gap_bytes
fields.evidence: Raw byte-level fact confirmed in cap-01-future-1.sav; semantic purpose (reserved growth space vs. fixed padding) is UNKNOWN.
